Result Report GUJENERG reported standalone EBITDA of INR8.0bn, down by 38.5% QoQ due to weaker Trading business margins and lower Morbi volumes but improved 24.0% YoY.
EBITDA from the Trading business stood at INR3.3bn, down 54.9% QoQ, while CGD EBITDA declined 20.4% QoQ to INR4.6bn.
